# Содержимое файла countries.ts {#sec-api-countries .appendix}

``` python
import {Request, Response} from 'express'
import { createDb, getQuery } from '../../db/queryDb';
import { UserRoleType } from '../../types/user';

type CountriesTopReqType = {
    timeStart: number,
    timeEnd: number,
    limit: number,
    clientId: number
}

export const getCountriesTop = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    let adminId: null | number = null;
    const {timeStart, timeEnd, limit, clientId}: CountriesTopReqType = req.body

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const clientIpResp = await getQuery<{
            clientIp: string,
            role: UserRoleType
        }>(
            db,
            'SELECT ip_addr as clientIp, role FROM vpn_users WHERE id = ?',
            [clientId]
        )

        const clientIp = clientIpResp[0]?.clientIp
        const clientRole = clientIpResp[0].role

        if (!!clientIp) {
            const countries = await getQuery<{
                country: string,
                count: number,
                lat: number,
                lon: number
            }>(
                db,
                `SELECT "geo.resp.country_code" AS country, COUNT(*) AS count, "geo.resp.latitude" AS lat, "geo.resp.longitude" AS lon
                FROM conn
                WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND
                ts >= ? AND ts <= ? AND
                "id.orig_h" = ?
                GROUP BY country
                ORDER BY count DESC;`,
                [timeStart, timeEnd, clientIp]
            )

            if (clientRole === 'node') {
                const clientDependResp = await getQuery<{
                    id: number
                }>(
                    db,
                    'SELECT admin_id as id FROM node_depends WHERE node_id = ?',
                    [clientId]
                )

                adminId = clientDependResp[0].id
            }

            let blackListCountriesResp = await getQuery<{
                countries: string
            }>(
                db,
                'SELECT countries_codes AS countries FROM block_countries WHERE clientId = ?',
                [!!adminId ? adminId : clientId]
            )

            let blackListCountries = blackListCountriesResp[0].countries

            const blacklistSet = new Set(
                blackListCountries
                    ? blackListCountries.split(',').map(code => code.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean)
                    : []
            );

            const enriched = countries.map(item => ({
                ...item,
                blackList: blacklistSet.has(item.country.toUpperCase())
            }));

            db.close()

            res.json({
                success: true,
                info: {
                    countries: enriched
                }
            })
        } else {
            db.close()

            res.json({
                success: true,
                info: {
                    countries: []
                }
            })
        }
    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            info: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}
```
